question: Can an entrance-node-specific public credential, localized by a strict Panoramax ray and accumulated across source-blind direct views, turn geometric entrance visibility into exact entrance identity evidence?

cohort.duplicate_rule: At most one entrance per (target way, normalized credential), while distinct credentials on the same target way are retained as an exact-entrance hard negative.
cohort.view_selection: Among strict-orientation DIRECT items, take the farthest, median, and nearest camera-to-entrance distances; use every item when fewer than three exist. Pixels and OCR outputs are forbidden during selection.

credential.name_alias_variants: full normalized node name plus delimiter-separated segments of at least four characters
credential.authority_rule: Only an entrance-node-specific name or house-number match inside the strict node-ray window may authorize exact entrance identity. Building names, facade appearance, geometry alone, and other-entrance aliases cannot authorize it.

claim_boundary: A pass is entrance-node-specific text-credential evidence on curated real Panoramax Development views. It is not a portal mask, public or legal access, walkability, collision-free motion, metric arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, user benefit, or safety evidence.
